status: owner-approved; freeze before any candidate match evaluation

owner_decision.reply: Okay. Let's proceed with your first option for question 2.
owner_decision.selection: Approve this initial bar and match budget
owner_decision.scope: First measured conventional Chess release; no human Elo claim; no paid compute

mode: untimed M2 AutoClaim, orthodox-start full known history

stockfish.interpretation: Explicit depth handicap; no unrestricted-Stockfish or human rating inference

population.draws: IID mixture, balanced in expectation: each root chooses uniform family and independent uniform extra length4..8 once; hold both fixed through rejection attempts
population.continuation: Uniform lexically enumerated authoritative native legal board actions; SHA256 counter/rejection PRNG; no candidate/opponent evaluation
population.filter: Native live outcome, no available AutoClaim, full requested prefix reached, absolute frozen material-v1 white score<=100cp; exclude exact frozen development prefixes
population.exhaustion: Study ineligible; no widened filter, replacement family or seed retry
population.duplicates: Holdout draws sampled with replacement; retain and report duplicates; do not deduplicate or exclude between the two formal arms
population.development: Separate public seed msh49-development-2026-11-08-v1; 12roots; freeze exact development catalog before tuning; independent holdout sampling excludes that fixed set
population.holdout: After candidate executable/source, protocol, sampler and development hashes freeze, obtain one fresh256-bit entropy seed. Derive relative/external streams by distinct labels; publish seed, full roots and rejection counts; no heldout evaluation before freeze. No outcome-based redraw.
population.scope: Randomized short legal continuations from authored opening families, conditional on fixed filters; not a human-game corpus or general chess population
population.random_streams: SHA256 domain includes population ID, seed, arm label, draw index, fixed u64MAX header or numbered attempt, and counter; little-endian u64 rejection removes modulo bias

relative_arm.unit: Two reversed-color games from one independently sampled root
relative_arm.sign: Candidate pair halfpoint sum minus2; ties excluded

external_arm.unit: Four matched games per root: candidate and baseline each play Stockfish in both colors
external_arm.mean_gate: Sum of candidate pair halfpoints minus baseline pair halfpoints strictly positive
external_arm.sign: Candidate pair halfpoints minus baseline pair halfpoints at each root; ties excluded

inference.null: For each arm, Pr(positive paired difference | difference!=0)<=1/2 under its independently sampled opening distribution
inference.alternative: Positive paired difference is more likely than negative conditional on nonzero difference
inference.pvalue: Exact one-sided upper Binomial(n,1/2) tail from k positive signs among n non-ties; n=0 gives1
inference.threshold: p<=0.05 in BOTH arms, compare integer20*tail_numerator<=2^n
inference.separate_gates: Observed score floors and positive external mean are operational gates; sign test is not a confidence bound or hypothesis test on mean score
inference.multiplicity: Conjunctive co-primary intersection-union completion: both arms and all eligibility/operational gates must pass. No simultaneous95% mean-interval claim.
inference.fixed_sample: Run the two fixed samples once. No optional success stopping, dropped failed pairs, extra roots, fresh-seed retry after failure, or post-holdout candidate tuning. An incomplete study cannot pass.
inference.assumption: IID opening draws are an experimental assumption implemented by the specified label-domain pseudorandom sampler; inference is conditional on this declared population, not general human chess

eligibility.games: Every planned game must conclude natively; no process/protocol/cleanup/diagnostic failure, output truncation, work fallback, incomplete response or unscored cap
eligibility.search: Audit every actual go/bestmove for completed depth>0 and score telemetry; reject mShogi fallback diagnostics. Native controller claims may conclude without go; intended claim move is not played.
eligibility.records: Existing strict Rust report replay, exact config/executable/model/history/limits/color identities and intact prior output files
eligibility.failure: Preserve actual reports and mark study ineligible; never score failure as loss/draw or silently omit a pair
eligibility.budget: Total charged match work<=7200seconds is mandatory forPASS; any overrun makes study ineligible even if game scores pass

budget.already_spent_pre_target_calibration: Count54seconds conservatively (ceil of actual calibrated invocation wall time)
budget.accounting: Sum measured active match-run invocation wall time, including development, baseline and formal arms; testing/build/CI separate. Stop scheduling new pairs/batches at budget. Existing in-flight match remains bounded by native/protocol/ply and cleanup policies; record any overrun and do not extend budget to force success.

io_rationale: Caller-configured within existing admitted bounds:2MiB transcript retains up to512ply full-position commands; oneopeningpair per invocation staysbelowaggregate report cap. No product limits/defaults changed.
